text:
Ava: Noticed elevated 5xxs from transformer-svc -> chunk-storage starting ~08:43 UTC. Traces show long DNS resolution times on requests that did retries.

Riley: I pulled the CoreDNS metrics: p50 went from ~12ms -> 220ms, p99 spiking to multiple seconds. SERVFAIL and UDP retrans counts increased around the same time.

Sam: Which zone? Any pattern by GPU pool?

Ava: Mostly us-west2 (gpu-spot-usw2-*). Nodes impacted include gpu-node-12..15 and gpu-node-21. Packet counters show RX errors and a higher-than-normal fragmented packet rate on the 100Gb NICs.

Riley: CoreDNS log excerpt from gpu-node-12:
```
2026-03-18T08:42:58Z [WARN] lookup failed: read udp 10.1.5.12:50721->10.0.0.9:53: i/o timeout
2026-03-18T08:43:01Z [INFO] cache: miss for chunk-storage.prod.svc.cluster.local
```

Sam: I captured a short pcap from a sidecar; uploaded to S3: https://s3.company.internal/incidents/INF-4210/pcap.tar.gz — the trace shows DNS queries being sent with no UDP reply for some queries, then retries and occasional TCP fallback.

Ava: Quick repro from a pod:
```
kubectl exec -n prod svc-debug -- nslookup chunk-storage.prod.svc.cluster.local
# sometimes returns in ~2.4s, other times immediate
```

ops-oncall: I'm going to run two limited mitigations on a canary host set (gpu-node-12/13) while we investigate:
- lower MTU from 9000 -> 8950 on the host to reduce fragmentation over the east-west fabric
- add a conservative backoff to node-local-dns forwarder so it doesn't rapidly flood CoreDNS during fabric hiccups

Riley: Pushing canary node-local-dns config (forwarder_backoff=200ms, cache_ttl=45s) to the two nodes now.

infra-bot: node-local-dns config rollout started -> v2026-03-18-canary at 1795000020

Sam: After the MTU clamp on gpu-node-12, DNS p99 there dropped from ~2.3s -> ~150ms and NIC RX error counters decreased to baseline. Good signal on canary.

Ava: Can we expand the MTU tweak to the rest of the affected ASG and schedule NIC firmware verification + RDMA stack log collection? I noticed rdma reprobes in dmesg on a subset of nodes which could indicate link-layer issues.

ops-oncall: Filed INF-4210 with dashboards (dns_latency p50/p95/p99), NIC counters, and the pcap link. Scheduling NIC firmware audit and rdma/kernel log collection for 02:30 UTC tomorrow. Paging @kernel-rdma and @nic-firmware teams.

Riley: Also opening a small runtime PR to add exponential backoff and a cap on outstanding forwarder queries in node-local-dns to avoid short-term amplification to CoreDNS. Will link the PR in INF-4210.

Ava: TL;DR:
- Impact: intermittent DNS stalls in us-west2 causing internal RPC retries and 5xxs for transformer->chunk-storage
- Canary mitigations: MTU clamp + node-local-dns forwarder backoff reduced p99 latency significantly on canary hosts
- Next: expand canary, run NIC firmware/kernel checks, implement forwarder backoff PR, and produce a post-incident writeup in INF-4210

Sam: I'll keep monitoring the dashboards and post updates here. If anyone sees a regression after canary expansion please @ops-oncall in this thread.

ops-oncall: Thanks all. Will update the ticket and run the overnight monitoring job to watch for recurrence.

Ava: Thanks team :thumbsup:
